reason.wifi_switch: Physical ports: {ports} for APs + spare uplinks per switch{note}.
reason.access_switch: Physical ports: {ports} for wall sockets + uplink {uplink}{note}. L2, no PoE.
reason.camera_poe_ok: PoE budget {budget} W covers ~{per} cameras (estimate {est} W).
reason.camera_poe_over: ⚠️ Estimated draw ({est} W) is CLOSE TO/ABOVE the {budget} W budget — check camera power.
reason.bt_upgrade: All-802.3bt model selected: {bt} need 802.3bt PoE to run every radio.
reason.core: Traffic aggregation: {n} at the access layer. The 10G core terminates all uplinks.
reason.core_redundant: Traffic aggregation: {n} at the access layer. {qty}× {model} in a stack/MC-LAG — N+1 core redundancy for a critical site (losing one does not take the network down).
reason.fw_switch_limit: FortiLink limit: manages up to {limit} switches (need {need}).
reason.fw_10g: Has 10G SFP+ ports for fibre uplinks.
reason.fw_throughput: Threat protection {tp} Gbps covers {need} Gbps of inspected traffic (~{pct}%).
reason.fw_none: {need} switches on site — above the limit of every listed model.
reason.fw_ha: HA pair (active-passive) — a single firewall is an unacceptable single point of failure for a critical site.
reason.ups_legacy: Estimated active equipment load ≈{w} W (excluding camera/AP PoE). Choose a UPS with ≥30% headroom and the runtime the site requires.
reason.ups: Load ≈{w} W: equipment {eq} W + PoE {poe} W (APs and cameras, incl. PSU efficiency). Needs ≥{va} VA with {head}% headroom. Confirm the required runtime.
reason.oob: Independent access path to the firewall/consoles if the main link fails — essential for remote recovery without a site visit.
reason.dac: Short 10G links within one rack (switches ↔ core ↔ FortiGate) — a DAC is cheaper and more reliable than a pair of optics.
reason.sr: Fibre uplinks between closets ({idf} closets/IDF): 2 transceivers per link.
reason.gc: {model} has no SFP+: switches connect with a 1G copper SFP into the FortiLink port.
reason.patch_panels: {n} copper ports (sockets, cameras, APs) ÷ {ports} ports per panel.
reason.patch_cords: One patch cord per used port.
reason.cable_managers: Horizontal cable managers for tidy patching.
reason.rack_idf: Extra racks for remote IDF closets: {n} (90 m copper limit).
reason.spare: {pct}% of {qty} pcs (minimum 1) — swap immediately instead of waiting for RMA at the “{tier}” level.
reason.management: FortiManager / FortiAnalyzer (or FortiGate Cloud) — central configuration management and log retention. FAZ size depends on log volume (GB/day).
bundle.utp.content: ATP + web filtering, DNS filtering, anti-botnet.
bundle.enterprise.content: UTP + CASB, DLP, IoT detection, attack-surface rating, AI inline malware prevention.
detail.ap_power: Draws up to {w} W, PoE class 802.3{cls}.
detail.poe_load: AP PoE load: {load} W total, ~{per} W per switch (budget {budget} W).
detail.bt_ports: APs needing 802.3bt: {bt}; 802.3bt ports in the selected switches: {cap}.
detail.camera_watts: Estimated camera draw: {w} W (editable in the inputs).
detail.agg_auto: Core is added automatically when access switches ≥ {thr}.
detail.ups_legacy: For comparison: the prototype's rough estimate ≈{w} W (without PoE).
detail.links_core: Links: {edge} switch → core, {fw} core ↔ FortiGate, {icl} between cores (ICL).
detail.sku_hint: SKU pattern: {sku} (DD = 12/36/60 months, confirm with your distributor).
fw.skip_throughput: {model}: threat protection {tp} Gbps is not enough for {need} Mbps with headroom.
check.no_input: Enter sockets, cameras or access points — the BoM appears automatically.
check.psu_confirm: For the “{tier_label}” level, switches with two power supplies (hot-swap) are recommended. Please confirm.
check.psu_confirm_hint: Until confirmed, the tier's recommendation is applied. Toggle “2 power supplies” in the inputs.
check.poe_over: {cat}: PoE load ~{load} W per switch exceeds the {budget} W budget.
check.poe_over_hint: Add switches, choose a model with a larger budget or check device power.
check.poe_near: {cat}: PoE load ~{load} W — {pct}% of the {budget} W budget.
check.poe_near_hint: Keep at least 20% of the budget as headroom.
check.poe_single_psu: {cat}: if one PSU fails, the PoE budget drops to {single} W while the load is ~{load} W — some devices will lose power.
check.poe_autoscale: {cat}: quantity raised from {before} to {after} because of the PoE budget.
check.bt_upgrade: {bt} APs need 802.3bt but {base} has only {cap} such ports — {premium} selected automatically.
check.bt_ports: {bt} APs need 802.3bt but {model} has only {cap} such ports.
check.bt_ports_hint: Choose {premium} or run some APs on 802.3at (with radio limitations).
check.agg_off_many: Core is off but there are {n} switches: they will connect directly/daisy-chained to the FortiGate.
check.agg_off_many_hint: With 4+ switches a core is recommended — fewer bottlenecks and simpler redundancy.
check.core_ports: {edge} switches do not fit one {model} (up to {cap} connections) — {groups} core groups added.
check.core_ports_hint: Consider a higher-density core (e.g. FS-1048E) or two-tier aggregation.
check.fw_none: No model in the ladder fits ({need} switches).
check.fw_none_hint: A larger model (FG-600G+) or several FortiGates are required.
check.fw_fortios: {model}: the {value}-FortiSwitch limit needs FortiOS {min}+; older versions allow {base}. Sized for FortiOS {version}.
check.fw_ha_sku: {model} for HA: “-HA” SKUs exist and are bought as a pair.
check.oversub_hint: Add a second uplink or use faster ports.
check.eoo: {model} is End-of-Order — confirm availability or choose a replacement.
check.eoo_hint: Replace the model in the catalog.
check.unverified: Data for {models} comes from third-party sources — verify against the official datasheet before quoting.
check.reserve: A +{pct}% reserve was applied to sockets, cameras and APs before sizing switches.
check.idf: Farthest point {run} m > {limit} m (copper limit): ~{n} (IDF) needed.
check.idf_hint: Place switches closer to users; uplink to the core over fibre.
check.dual_wan: Two WAN links from different ISPs are recommended (FortiGate SD-WAN).
check.suspicious: Very large values — please check the inputs.
check.clients_per_ap: ~{per} clients per access point — too many for comfortable Wi-Fi.
ip.overflow: base network is too small for all segments
